ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   C. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
